lines.text: Hello, friend. I'm Only-He-Stands-There. Welcome to Balmora. If you have a question, I'll be happy to answer it. Or try, anyway. And if it's just a little advice you'd like, that's fine, too.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: I am Only-He-Stands-There. Healer Service.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: I don't know what your business with him is, but be careful. Caius Cosades may appear to be a pathetic old man, but don't judge by appearances. Some people made that mistake a while ago, and now they're not with us anymore.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: I will stop training others in Restoration.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: Look at these people, %PCName. They cannot afford the services of the Mages Guild. Is it wrong to make their lives easier? Perhaps you can convince me.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: Please reconsider, %PCName. I believe I am offering a vital service to these people. But I perhaps you can still convince me.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: Report back to Ranis Athrys and remember our agreement.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: Report back to Ranis Athrys and remember our agreement.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: So, your name is %PCName? And you're new here in Balmora? Well, my name is Only-He-Stands-There. And I don't mind answering questions. I have nothing else on my mind right now. And if I start to bore you about Morrowind lore, just let me know.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: Then you have your orders. You know what you must do. I am prepared to die.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: They are... activists. I prefer to make the case against slavery by example. If the Dunmer know me as kind and helpful, perhaps they will come to see all Argonians the same way.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: Tsiya has a little bit of a 'sweet tooth,' if you know what I mean. I heard her connection hasn't arrived yet, though, and she's been acting a bit jumpy.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: Very well. I shall stop offering training. Tell Ranis Athrys that I will not interfere with her... authority any more.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: Very well. I will offer you training after you've reported back to Ranis Athrys.

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: What if, hypothetically, you were to return to Ranis Athrys and tell her that I agreed to stop any unsanctioned training... And suppose that if you did that, I decided to offer training to my good friend %PCName?

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: What? I don't offer any services. Who told you that?

lines.speaker: onlyhestandsthere
lines.text: You told me not to offer training. I have not.

lines.speaker: peeradeeh
lines.text: I am Peeradeeh. Slave.

lines.speaker: peeradeeh
lines.text: You do not know? Peeradeeh was sure... But you should be a member. If Peeradeeh asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: rasha
lines.text: Greetings, traveler. Rasha wishes you well and thinks you maybe can help him with some pressing business.

lines.speaker: rasha
lines.text: I will find another way to deliver my shirts, you who are not helpful.

lines.speaker: rasha
lines.text: It is good the shirts have been delivered. I thank you.

lines.speaker: rasha
lines.text: Most excellent, yes? We will both gain from this...I shall keep my good name, and you shall benefit from Teneran's generosity. Wonderful. Take care, %PCName, one should not take an oath sworn to Zenithar lightly. No, never lightly.

lines.speaker: rasha
lines.text: Must get fine shirts to marketplace.

lines.speaker: rasha
lines.text: No? Very sad for both of us. We both stood to gain much. Perhaps you are already cursed by Zenithar, yes? Perhaps he will not accept your oath. I must go. I don't want your curse to be rubbing off on me. No, not on me.

lines.speaker: rasha
lines.text: Yes, to Teneran my fine shirts must go. She is in Ald'ruhn, under the big shell.

lines.speaker: rasha
lines.text: Yes, we have made our arrangement. Now go, Oath-Swearer. You must deliver those shirts for me.

lines.speaker: rasha
lines.text: Yes. Most pressing. I have, you see, a shipment of clothing...fine clothing, it is...to get to Ald-ruhn. But, I fear other business draws me away. Perhaps, I think, you and I might come to an arrangement, yes? If you will deliver Rasha's shirts...these fine, fine shirts...to Bivale Teneran the clothier in Ald-ruhn, she will pay you for your services. And a generous woman she is. I would ask that you swear an oath to Zenithar to seal our arrangement, though. Yes. What do you think of my offer, hmmmm?

lines.speaker: rasha
lines.text: You swore by Zenithar you would deliver my shirts. Please, go now. I have given you the shirt from my back, and must have that delivery.

lines.speaker: rasha
lines.text: Your help was appreciated, friend of Rasha.

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: Greetings, Reeh-Jah. I'm Reeh-Jah. Everyone here in Molag Mar is involved with the Temple outpost or pilgrimages in some way. Is there some specific place nearby you'd like to visit?

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: I am Reeh-Jah. Slave.

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: I'm Reeh-Jah, and this is Molag Mar, a Temple outpost for pilgrims and Temple warriors. Are you looking for services? Or could you use a little advice?

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: No! I should have known you bounty hunter! Don't hurt me. I'll come along. Just don't hurt me no more.

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: No, not home. To the Argonian Mission in Ebonheart before they find me, that's where I must go. The Tel Aruhn hunters be out looking for me, no doubt about it. If they find Reeh-Jah, that's it for me!

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: Okay. Don't tell no one you seen me, okay? I'm off now.

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: One day, I will hopefully get there.

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: Please to meet you, %PCName. I'm Reeh-Jah. This is Molag Mar. This outpost is maintained by the Temple for pilgrims and Temple warriors. Apart from the Ordinators and Buoyant Armigers here, everyone is either a pilgrim or a tradesman or craftsman servicing the pilgrims. Is there something I can do for you?

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: Pleased to meet you. I'm Reeh-Jah. This is your first visit to Molag Mar? I don't believe we spoken before. Is there anything I can do for you?

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: That's me.

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: Who...who are you? You go now! Leave me alone. I must get home now.

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: Yes, home.

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: You do not know? Reeh-Jah was sure... But you should be a member. If Reeh-Jah asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: reeh_jah
lines.text: You want to help me? That a rare thing in these parts, I tell you what. Maybe you get us there, maybe not, but I rather be on my way than have them find me here.

lines.speaker: reemukeeus
lines.text: I am Reemukeeus. Slave.

lines.speaker: reemukeeus
lines.text: You do not know? Reemukeeus was sure... But you should be a member. If Reemukeeus asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: reesa
lines.text: And good day to you, %PCName. I'm Reesa. I assume you're new to Sadrith Mora, since we've never spoken before. I know most everyone in town. Can I help you find someone in particular?

lines.speaker: reesa
lines.text: I am Reesa. Slave.

lines.speaker: reesa
lines.text: Yes. I'm Reesa. Go ahead. I'm sure you have questions.

lines.speaker: reesa
lines.text: You do not know? Reesa was sure... But you should be a member. If Reesa asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: seewul
lines.text: I am Seewul. Slave.

lines.speaker: seewul
lines.text: I'm fine, thank you, %PCName. You can call me Seewul. First visit to Suran? We get lots of pilgrims here, since the birthplace of Molag Bal and Fields of Kummu nearby are a popular pilgrimage sites. Is there some specific place you'd like to see?

lines.speaker: seewul
lines.text: I'm Seewul. This is the village of Suran, gateway to Bal Ur. Are you looking for services here? Or was there something else I can do for you?

lines.speaker: seewul
lines.text: Pleased to meet you. I'm Seewul. New here? I'm sure you have some questions for me.

lines.speaker: seewul
lines.text: Welcome to Suran, gem of the Ascadian Isles. I'm Seewul. What brings you to our fair village? Are you looking for someone in particular?

lines.speaker: seewul
lines.text: You do not know? Seewul was sure... But you should be a member. If Seewul asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: servant arg male
lines.text: I am Utadeek. Slave.

lines.speaker: servant arg male
lines.text: I'm Utadeek, and you're in the village of Gnisis. If there's some specific place you're looking for, I can probably help you. Or if you're just killing time, I'd be happy to share a little Morrowind lore, or swap the latest rumors.

lines.speaker: servant arg male
lines.text: This is Gnisis, %PCName. Just a little mining village on a trade route. I'm Utadeek. Is there something specific I can help you with? Or are you just looking for a little advice?

lines.speaker: servant arg male
lines.text: Welcome to Gnisis, %PCName. I'm Utadeek. Can I help you find someone in particular? Or are you just looking for a little advice from a local?

lines.speaker: servant arg male
lines.text: Welcome, %PCName. I'm Utadeek. You're in the village of Gnisis. If you're a pilgrim, you're probably looking for the Mask of Vivec at the Gnisis Temple. Otherwise, I can help you find what you are looking for.

lines.speaker: servant arg male
lines.text: You do not know? Utadeek was sure... But you should be a member. If Utadeek asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: servant arg male
lines.text: You're in the village of Gnisis. I'm Utadeek. Can I help you? If you're looking for services in Gnisis, we're pretty limited -- just a mining village, a temple, and a small Legion garrison.

lines.speaker: skeetul
lines.text: I am Skeetul. Commoner.

lines.speaker: skeetul
lines.text: I'm Skeetul, Commoner. Welcome to Ald'ruhn, the district seat of House Redoran. Are you looking for someone in particular?

lines.speaker: skeetul
lines.text: Pleased to meet you. I'm Skeetul, Commoner. Welcome to Ald'ruhn. What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: skeetul
lines.text: Sorry. I can't help you.

lines.speaker: skeetul
lines.text: Welcome to Ald'ruhn, %PCName. I'm Skeetul, Commoner. Are you new here? I don't believe we've met.

lines.speaker: skeetul
lines.text: You don't look familiar. I'm Skeetul. Can I help you? Are you looking for some specific place here in Ald'ruhn? Or is there something else you want?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Yes, of course, friend. Take this potion back to Edwinna, along with my apologies. Speak with me again next time you are here. I may have some duties for you.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Yes, of course, soft-skin. Take this potion back to Edwinna, along with my apologies. Speak with me again next time you are here. I may have some duties for you.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: The Ahemmusa camp is on the northeast corner of Vvardenfell. Take a ship to Tel Vos and go north up the coast. If you reach the sea, you have gone too far.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Ah, thank you %PCName. Minabibi has already answered many of my questions.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Ah, the current Guildmaster. It is rumored that he was promoted to his current position to get him out of Cyrodiil. It is a shame that men can have power without wisdom. It is different for us lizards.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Ah, the current Guildmaster. It is rumored that he was promoted to his current position to get him out of Cyrodiil. It is one of the weaknesses of the soft-skins. They can have power without wisdom.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: And good day to you, %PCName. I'm Skink-in-Tree's-Shade. I assume you're new to Sadrith Mora, since we've never spoken before. I know most everyone in town. Can I help you find someone in particular?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Did Tenyeminwe make it safely to the ship?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Did you put a stop to Telura Ulver's necromancy?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Do not be discouraged. I fear it may take weeks or even months to find a copy.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Escort her to Gals Arethi's ship, the Elf-Skerring. It's at the Telvanni docks.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Find out what you need for advancement and speak with me again.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: For now, just deliver the potion back to Edwinna in Ald'ruhn.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Forgive me. I can only serve members of the Mages Guild.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Have you found a copy of Galur Rithari's Papers?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Have you found a copy of Vampires of Vvardenfell?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Have you found Galur Rithari's papers?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Have you found the second volume yet?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Have you found the soul of an Ash Ghoul?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I am concerned about the continuing problems with these strange Ash creatures. Perhaps if I had a soul of one of these creatures to study... Would you bring me the soul of an Ash Ghoul?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I am glad to hear that Tenyeminwe made it to the Elf-Skerring safely. You have my thanks.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I am honored to have worked with you, %PCName, and I have one more task. Take this letter to Arch-Mage Trebonius in Vivec.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I am impressed, %PCName. But did you not bring the papers with you?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I am looking for a rare book, Vampires of Vvardenfell.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I am Skink-in-Tree's-Shade, Sorcerer and Master Wizard of the Mages Guild.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I am Skink-in-Tree's-Shade. Sorcerer.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I believe she was planning to return to Summerset Isle.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I cannot discuss these matters with you. You have been expelled.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I cannot discuss these matters with you. You have been expelled.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I cannot discuss these matters with you. You have been expelled.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I cannot discuss these matters with you. You have been expelled.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I cannot discuss these matters with you. You have been expelled.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I do not have duties for you now. Speak with me again when you have the rank of Wizard.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I have another task for you, Wizard, but it is a difficult one. I believe there is another book on Vampires, Galur Rithari's papers.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I have given you the potion, %PCName. Return it to Edwinna in Ald'ruhn.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I have not yet had word from Arch-Mage Trebonius in Vivec. Until then, I must consider you expelled.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I have not yet had word from Arch-Mage Trebonius in Vivec. Until then, I must consider you expelled.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I have not yet had word from Arch-Mage Trebonius in Vivec. Until then, I must consider you expelled.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I have not yet had word from Arch-Mage Trebonius in Vivec. Until then, I must consider you expelled.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I have not yet had word from Arch-Mage Trebonius in Vivec. Until then, I must consider you expelled.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I heard Edwinna finally got her potion.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I hope you didn't use the scrolls and gems I gave you. I do not have any more.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I may have duties for you later, %PCName. Right now I am busy making a Detect Creatures potion for Edwinna in Ald'ruhn.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I need someone to escort the scholar Tenyeminwe.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I only know of one that has been somewhat abandoned in recent years. The Tharys Ancestral Tomb is just northeast of Seyda Neen. There are tombs closer to Vivec, but the Dunmer might take offense at your explorations.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I thank you for the book, %PCName.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I'm at your service. Are you here for duties or advancement?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: I'm Master Wizard rank in Mages Guild, and I'd think twice about going down in a Daedric ruin without a crateful of potions and scrolls.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: It is a cavern on the mainland just northwest of Tel Aruhn. Swim or fly northwest, cross one island, and you should see the cave entrance ahead on the mainland. It has been taken over by the Sixth House, so be careful.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: It is always a shame when any wizard turns to necromancy.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: It may be hard to find. Go to Hla Oad and head north along the road. When you cross the wooden bridge, stay left along the coast until you come to another bridge to an island. Shal is on that island. The door faces the swamp, just north of a Daedric ruin.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Kill the necromancer Telura Ulver and report back to me.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: No, I already heard what happened. You are responsible for her death. You are not a trustworthy %PCRace.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: No, you cannot fool me. You are not carrying any suitable soul gems.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Oh? You have a copy? Bring it to me.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Please keep looking, %PCName.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Speak with the Wise Women of the Ashlander tribes. From what I've heard, I doubt the Erabenimsun or the Urshilaku would agree. The Zainab might agree, but I would speak with the Ahemmusa first.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Take the letter to Trebonius in Vivec.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Telvanni spies? Yes, I suspect there is at least one. I do not know who or where. While Sadrith Mora may be the obvious target, I would try looking in Vivec. That's where Guild decisions are actually made.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Tenyeminwe is staying at Muriel's Cornerclub. She is concerned about some trouble she had with a Telvanni last night. She wants to leave Sadrith Mora on the Elf-Skerring but is afraid to go to the docks. If you escort her to Gals Arethi's ship, I would be grateful.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Thank you for bringing me Galur Rithari's papers, %PCName.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: The Dunmer bury their dead in such tombs. It is best to avoid offending the Dunmer by entering them. There are rules to govern such things, but I do not fully understand them.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: The Necromancer is Telura Ulver, a former Mages Guild member. She may be found in Shal.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: The soul of any ash ghoul should be suitable. I believe the nearest ash ghoul is in Yakin. Scrolls are more reliable than spells, so take these scrolls, and these two soul gems.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: There are two books in this series. The first is common in Morrowind. Most rare booksellers have a copy. The second volume is rare. If you can find a copy of volume two, I would be grateful. You might try a rare bookseller.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Well, have you found one?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Were you able to arrange a meeting?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: What do you wish of me, Arch-Mage?

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: When any mage turns to Necromancy, it casts a pale shadow over the whole guild.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: While killing is never pleasant, it is sometimes necessary. Telura Ulver is dead. You have proven yourself to the Guild, %PCName.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Yes, Minabibi will stay here with me for a time.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Yes, thank you for bringing me the soul of an ash ghoul, Wizard.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Yes, these papers allegedly describe how an Ordinator from Bal Ur became a vampire and was cured. I would be most interested in a copy of this book. Ask booksellers and scholars. Someone surely knows where a copy is.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Yes, this is exactly what I was looking for... And it is in good condition, too. I hope 1000 septims will cover your expenses.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Yes, this is Excellent. A most interesting account. Please take this amulet with my gratitude.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Yes, this is Excellent. A most interesting account. Please take this amulet with my gratitude. Perhaps you should travel to the Shrine of Bal Ur yourself.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Yes, this will do nicely. I hope it wasn't too difficult.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Yes, you are the Arch-Mage now. I will help you in any way I can.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: Yes. I'm Skink-in-Tree's-Shade. Go ahead. I'm sure you have questions.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: You have done well. When you are ready for advancement, speak with me about duties again.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: You have performed all my duties honorably. I have one more thing to ask of you...

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: You may be able to assist me, %PCName. I would like to speak with one of the Wise Women of the Ashlanders. Perhaps you could arrange a meeting.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: You want my advice, rookie? I've been around. I've risen to Master Wizard rank in the Guild by being smart and careful. And if I were you, I'd stay away from Daedric ruins until you have a little more experience, and a heftier kit bag.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: You were still expelled from the Mages Guild last I heard. Be patient. The Guild does not move quickly here in Vvardenfell.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: You were still expelled from the Mages Guild last I heard. Be patient. The Guild does not move quickly here in Vvardenfell.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: You were still expelled from the Mages Guild last I heard. Be patient. The Guild does not move quickly here in Vvardenfell.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: You were still expelled from the Mages Guild last I heard. Be patient. The Guild does not move quickly here in Vvardenfell.

lines.speaker: skinkintreesshade
lines.text: You were still expelled from the Mages Guild last I heard. Be patient. The Guild does not move quickly here in Vvardenfell.

lines.speaker: smart_snake
lines.text: I am Smart-Snake. Slave.

lines.speaker: smart_snake
lines.text: You do not know? Smart-Snake was sure... But you should be a member. If Smart-Snake asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: smokeskin_killer
lines.text: Forgive me. I can only serve members of the Great House Telvanni.

lines.speaker: smokeskin_killer
lines.text: I am Smokeskin-Killer, Warrior and Retainer of the Great House Telvanni.

lines.speaker: smokeskin_killer
lines.text: I am Smokeskin-Killer. Warrior.

lines.speaker: smokeskin_killer
lines.text: Welcome to Tel Vos, %PCName. I'm Smokeskin-Killer. Master Aryon is our patron mage-lord, and a Telvanni councilor. As you can see, Tel Vos is a mixture of old Telvanni and new Imperial styles -- just like our Master Aryon. Can I help you find someone in particular?

lines.speaker: smokeskin_killer
lines.text: You're welcome. I'm Smokeskin-Killer. We don't mind visitors here in Tel Vos, as long as they're well-behaved. Can I help you find your way around?

lines.speaker: stream-murk
lines.text: Greetings, Stream-Murk. I'm Stream-Murk. Everyone here in Molag Mar is involved with the Temple outpost or pilgrimages in some way. Is there some specific place nearby you'd like to visit?

lines.speaker: stream-murk
lines.text: I am Stream-Murk. Slave.

lines.speaker: stream-murk
lines.text: I'm Stream-Murk, and this is Molag Mar, a Temple outpost for pilgrims and Temple warriors. Are you looking for services? Or could you use a little advice?

lines.speaker: stream-murk
lines.text: Please to meet you, %PCName. I'm Stream-Murk. This is Molag Mar. This outpost is maintained by the Temple for pilgrims and Temple warriors. Apart from the Ordinators and Buoyant Armigers here, everyone is either a pilgrim or a tradesman or craftsman servicing the pilgrims. Is there something I can do for you?

lines.speaker: stream-murk
lines.text: Pleased to meet you. I'm Stream-Murk. This is your first visit to Molag Mar? I don't believe we spoken before. Is there anything I can do for you?

lines.speaker: stream-murk
lines.text: You do not know? Stream-Murk was sure... But you should be a member. If Stream-Murk asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: swims-in-swells
lines.text: I am Swims-In-Swells. Smuggler.

lines.speaker: tanan
lines.text: I am Tanan. Slave.

lines.speaker: tanan
lines.text: You do not know? Tanan was sure... But you should be a member. If Tanan asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: tee_lan
lines.text: I am Tee-Lan. Sharpshooter.

lines.speaker: tee_lan
lines.text: I'm Tee-Lan, Sharpshooter. Welcome to Ald'ruhn, the district seat of House Redoran. Are you looking for someone in particular?

lines.speaker: tee_lan
lines.text: Pleased to meet you. I'm Tee-Lan, Sharpshooter. Welcome to Ald'ruhn. What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: tee_lan
lines.text: Sorry. I can't help you.

lines.speaker: tee_lan
lines.text: Welcome to Ald'ruhn, %PCName. I'm Tee-Lan, Sharpshooter. Are you new here? I don't believe we've met.

lines.speaker: tee_lan
lines.text: You don't look familiar. I'm Tee-Lan. Can I help you? Are you looking for some specific place here in Ald'ruhn? Or is there something else you want?

lines.speaker: teegla
lines.text: Almsivi, %PCName. I'm Teegla. Don't worry. Vivec can be confusing for us, and we live here. Is there some specific place you want? Or someone in particular you're trying to find?

lines.speaker: teegla
lines.text: I am Teegla. Slave.

lines.speaker: teegla
lines.text: Welcome to Vivec, %PCName. I'm Teegla. Are you looking for services in the sacred city? Maybe I can help.

lines.speaker: teegla
lines.text: You do not know? Teegla was sure... But you should be a member. If Teegla asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Ah, yes. Well, I uhh, lost contact with my supplier. Yes, that's it. So I've been forced to discontinue the extra bargains. Sorry.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Do I look like I hatched yesterday?  Come back when you actually have some money.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Don't try that with me.  I'm not stupid.  Come back when you get the money.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Every now and then I'll have special bargains on certain items.  Just for valued customers like yourself, of course.  Check back with me on a regular basis, and I'll see if I can make you a deal.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Here's what I've heard. I've heard that the guy who writes 'The Common Tongue' is someone named Trels Varis. Now, this is not a name known to me personally. I make it a habit to know the names of people in Mournhold personally. And this guy I do not know. And other people I talk to also do not know. Which is noteworthy in itself. I make the guess that this guy is well-hid, and wants to stay well-hid. But where do I first hear about this guy? In the Craftsmen's Hall. So maybe that is a one place to look.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Here's what I've heard. I've heard that the guy who writes 'The Common Tongue' is someone named Trels Varis.... Oh. This person is dead? How unfortunate. Then you know more about him than I do.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Here's what I've heard. I've heard that the guy who writes 'The Common Tongue' is someone named Trels Varis.... Oh. This person is dead? How unfortunate. Then you know more about him than I do.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Hey, look.  I can't give away all my trade secrets, now can I?

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: I am 'Ten-Tongues' Weerhat. Pawnbroker.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: I don't know him. I just know OF him.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: I don't see why everyone has to assume that just because I'm capable of offering some very good prices on quality merchandise that there's something shady going on!  I was just telling Ahnia the other day that...ahh...err, nevermind.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: I might know something. And when I really like someone, I can go a long way out of my way to help that someone.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: I might know something. I find it pays to know things.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: If you're implying what I think you're implying, I am not amused.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: I'm sorry, who?  No, I didn't say Ahnia... you must have mis-heard me. Heh. Nope. Nothing to tell at all. Certainly not.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: It's a deal.  Come back again sometime, okay?

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: It's a deal.  Come back again, okay?

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: It's a deal.  Here you go!  Come back soon.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Just for you, friend, I've got a great deal here on a Hellfire scroll.  I'll part with it for a mere 60 drakes.  Interested?

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Look, I appreciate the interest, but I only offer extra deals to my valued customers.  Nothing personal.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Look, I didn't want anything to do with her.  She forced me into it. I swear!

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Look, I don't think we should talk any more about it.  Let's just forget the whole thing, okay?  Pretend I never said a word.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Nice try, %PCName.  Come back when you've got the cash for it.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: No, nothing special here. Not for the likes of you, anyway. Just what you see.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Nothing today.  My, ah, supplier hasn't contacted me lately.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Oh, it's YOU. What, have you come to run me completely out of business?

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Okay, okay.  She's a Khajiit.  An entrepreneur of sorts.  She'll meet me in the sewers beneath here from time to time, and have things for me to sell.  I try not to ask too many questions, you know?  She carries a pretty sharp knife.  So I just do business, like I always do.  There's no harm in it, right?  It's not like it's hurting anyone.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Okay, okay.... don't hurt me!  She's the one who's been giving me scrolls to sell.  She gave me this stolen book too, but no one can read it, so no one would buy it from me.  Just take it, and leave me alone.  I swear it wasn't my idea...

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Okay, okay.... don't hurt me!  She's the one who's been giving me scrolls to sell.  She gave me this stolen book too, but no one can read it, so no one would buy it from me.  Just take it, and leave me alone.  I swear it wasn't my idea... but it's not like the book will do you any good, anyway. From what I hear, the guy who owned it is dead.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: She didn't tell me where she got it, so I don't know.  Don't want to know, either.  It's not like it matters.  You can't read a thing in it anyway, except for somebody's name.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Special offers?  No, you took care of that, didn't you?  Did a good job of ruining my business while you were at it.  Thanks for nothing.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Suit yourself.  It'll be gone the next time you come back...

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Ten-Tongues does business with many adventurers -- hes and shes that run about the ruins down below. Now and then they find something nice, and they bring it to Ten-Tongues. Maybe you are this kind of person? If so, you see people down there, look like poor helpless people with no home? Maybe they are, and maybe they aren't. Maybe they are the Black Dart Gang, and they surprise you, kill you dead *snap* like that with one poison dart, take your stuff, and goodbye to you forever.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: This is your lucky day, friend!  I've got a brand new scroll of Illnea's Breath right here.  Want it?

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Welcome, %PCRace, welcome! The best deals in all of Mournhold can be found here. Low prices every day, and special offers as well! Please, take your time and look through my wares.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Well, I had a few extras, so I've marked this down for a quick sale!

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: Well, since you ask, it turns out I happen to have a Fifth Barrier scroll.  60 drakes.  Interested?

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: What do you mean?  I like you, %Pcname, and I'm just trying to make you a good offer.

lines.speaker: Ten-Tongues_Weerhat
lines.text: You did what? She's dead? Great. There goes my business. Look, I don't want any trouble. She gave me the scrolls, and she gave me this stolen book. Just take it, and leave me alone.

lines.speaker: tim-jush
lines.text: I am Tim-Jush. Slave.

lines.speaker: tim-jush
lines.text: I'm fine, thank you, %PCName. You can call me Tim-Jush. First visit to Suran? We get lots of pilgrims here, since the birthplace of Molag Bal and Fields of Kummu nearby are a popular pilgrimage sites. Is there some specific place you'd like to see?

lines.speaker: tim-jush
lines.text: I'm Tim-Jush. This is the village of Suran, gateway to Bal Ur. Are you looking for services here? Or was there something else I can do for you?

lines.speaker: tim-jush
lines.text: Pleased to meet you. I'm Tim-Jush. New here? I'm sure you have some questions for me.

lines.speaker: tim-jush
lines.text: Welcome to Suran, gem of the Ascadian Isles. I'm Tim-Jush. What brings you to our fair village? Are you looking for someone in particular?

lines.speaker: tim-jush
lines.text: You do not know? Tim-Jush was sure... But you should be a member. If Tim-Jush asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: I've heard you've got a price on your head. For a small fee, I can take care of that.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: Don't worry about me, %PCName. Just report back to the Fighter's Guild. If I must, I'll *swim* back to our home. I have friends in the Twin Lamps who can help.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: Don't worry about me, soft-skin. Report back to the Fighters Guild. If I have to, I'll just *swim* to the mainland.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: Forgive me. I can only serve members of the Thieves Guild.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: I am Tongue-Toad, Savant Service and Wet Ear of the Thieves Guild.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: I am Tongue-Toad. Savant Service.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: I'm Tongue-Toad, Savant Service. Welcome to Ald'ruhn, the district seat of House Redoran. Are you looking for someone in particular?

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: I'm Tongue-Toad. I do a little of this, a little of that.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: It's a worthy cause. Sorry, but this is all I can afford.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: Pleased to meet you. I'm Tongue-Toad, Savant Service. Welcome to Ald'ruhn. What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: Thank you, %PCName. I will leave soon. May Stendarr watch over you.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: That's not a problem for you now.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: The Fighters Guild licks the boots of the Camonna Tong. You wouldn't kill a brother thief, would you? Would you let me leave town and tell the Fighters Guild that I fled?

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: Tongue-Toad, at your service. I'm in the Guild.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: Welcome to Ald'ruhn, %PCName. I'm Tongue-Toad, Savant Service. Are you new here? I don't believe we've met.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: Well, word on the street is that you've got about %PCCrimeLevel gold on your head. As you're a Thieves Guild member in good standing, I should be able to fix that for %CrimeGoldDiscount gold. Sound fair to you?

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: What are you doing?!

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: What if I were to leave town? Would you let me go and report that I have fled?

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: What? The Fighters Guild sent you to kill me?

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: What? Why would they want me dead?

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: With such a high price on your head, everyone assumes you are a murderer. I don't know the details, and don't want to know. But Thieves Guild won't be pleased. We're judged by your actions, and we don't need a reputation for reckless violence.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: Yes, I will leave soon.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: Yes. I'm Tongue-Toad.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: Yes. That's me. Who asks?

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: You don't look familiar. I'm Tongue-Toad. Can I help you? Are you looking for some specific place here in Ald'ruhn? Or is there something else you want?

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: You have my contribution.

lines.speaker: tongue_toad
lines.text: You're right. We all must do our part. Here. It's not much, but it's all I can spare.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: All I wish is to find the people who will help me.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: As you wish. The hand of the Camonna Tong will speed you to your final rest.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Bah...I don't need your help! Leave my sight, fetcher!

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Excuse me, master, can you help me...please? I fear I am lost without your help. Please, can you aid a poor Argonian?

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Excuse me, mistress, can you help me...please? I fear I am lost without your help. Please, can you aid a poor Argonian?

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Here our journey ends, %PCRace. For bringing me to this place, I thank you. It has been a thorn in the side of the Camonna Tong for too long, too long. Be on your way, outlander, or with this Redguard, you will die. That is the choice I give you.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Here our journey ends, %PCRace. For bringing me to this place, I thank you. It has been a thorn in the side of the Camonna Tong for too long, too long. It seems the Redguard is dead already. That is acceptable. I have no further business with you.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: I am Tul. Monk.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Leave me alone, stranger.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Oh, kind and great one, recently escaped from the Dren Plantation am I. Very cruel they were to me there. Please, great friend, will you not help me? I have heard there is a place near here that will help those such as me, oh great and kind one. I beg you. A kindly Redguard who helps us is what I've heard.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Oh, kind and great one, recently escaped from the Dren Plantation am I. Very cruel they were to me there. Please, great friend, will you not help me? I have heard there is a place near here that will help those such as me, oh great and kind one. I beg you.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Oh, kind and great one, recently escaped from the Dren Plantation am I. Very cruel they were to me there. Please, great friend, will you not help me? I have heard there is a place near here that will help those such as me, oh great and kind one. I beg you.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Oh, thank you, thank you. You are too kind to Tul. Not like the guards at the Dren Plantation, and cruel, cruel Orvas Dren, the powerful master there. And the evil brothers Ienith, so cruel, so cruel. Thank you for helping deliver me from them.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Oh, thank you, thank you. You are too kind to Tul. Not like the guards at the Dren Plantation, and cruel, cruel Orvas Dren, the powerful master there. And the evil brothers Ienith, so cruel, so cruel. Thank you for helping deliver me from them.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Oh, thank you, thank you. You are too kind to Tul. Not like the guards at the Dren Plantation, and cruel, cruel Orvas Dren, the powerful master there. And the evil brothers Ienith, so cruel, so cruel. Thank you for helping deliver me from them.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Please, we've got to get to that place. Please hurry.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Shall we continue on? I must get to freedom.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Shall we continue to travel together, great friend?

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: That is wise, %PCRace. Go now. Leave this one to me.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: The only choice. Go now, and forget about all of this. Or, die where you stand. It matters not to me.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: The Twin Lamps? They...uh...brighten the way, oh most kind, wonderful and helpful friend. Your eyes are like twin lamps of hope, my gracious savior! Yes, that is it!

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Yes, great one. A Redguard who will help those like me. Perhaps he is nearby.

lines.speaker: tul
lines.text: Yes, powerful one. I, the poor slave, will wait here for you.

lines.speaker: twice_bitten
lines.text: I am Twice-Bitten. Slave.

lines.speaker: twice_bitten
lines.text: To the north and west I have heard, but it is just stories that are told.

lines.speaker: twice_bitten
lines.text: You do not know? Twice-Bitten was sure... But you should be a member. If Twice-Bitten asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: Ukawei
lines.text: Good day, Citizen %PCName. I'm Ukawei. This is Ebonheart, named for Castle Ebonheart and the Duke of Ebonheart, Duke Vedam Dren, by the grace of our Emperor, the Emperor's representative here in Vvardenfell District. Can I help you ?

lines.speaker: Ukawei
lines.text: Grace of the Nine, Citizen %PCName. I'm Ukawei. Welcome to Ebonheart, capital of Vvardenfell District. Are you looking for someone in particular?

lines.speaker: Ukawei
lines.text: Greeting, Citizen %PCName. I'm Ukawei. Can I help you? This your first visit to Ebonheart? Is there some specific place you seek?

lines.speaker: Ukawei
lines.text: I am Ukawei, Healer and Twin Lamps of the Twin Lamps.

lines.speaker: Ukawei
lines.text: I am Ukawei. Healer.

lines.speaker: Ukawei
lines.text: Welcome, Citizen %PCName. I'm Ukawei, and this is Ebonheart. If you're new here, you'll be wanting to ask about our many services for travelers. And I imagine you wouldn't mind a little advice?

lines.speaker: ula
lines.text: I am Ula. Slave.

lines.speaker: ula
lines.text: You do not know? Ula was sure... But you should be a member. If Ula asks, 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say, 'They light the way to freedom.'

lines.speaker: vistha_kai
lines.text: Do not harm the inmates. I will not tolerate you adding to their suffering. Indeed, they are brutal and ferocious, and they will kill you if they can. But you are their guests, and you may not harm them, or you will answer to me.

lines.speaker: vistha_kai
lines.text: For his own amusement, Divayth Fyr permits thieves to test their skills by attempting to steal the treasures he keeps below in the Corprusarium. The dangers are fearful. The inmates are savage, and they carry the most terrible disease on Tamriel. The treasures themselves are guarded by traps and terrors. And the guards, myself chief among them, will take great delight in trying to kill you. Those are the rules. Abide by them ,or leave.

lines.speaker: vistha_kai
lines.text: I am the guardian and peacekeeper of the Corprusarium. I have spent long years in service to Lord Fyr, first as a slave, then as a free hireling, and now as a friend and partner. He has been kind and generous to me, and I take his interests, and the interests of those he shelters, to heart. The treasures of his dungeon are open to sport, according to Lord Fyr's whim, and you're welcome to try to steal them. But I, too, find great sport in hunting thieves.

lines.speaker: vistha_kai
lines.text: I am Vistha-Kai, Warden of the Corprusarium. And you have killed one of the inmates that I am sworn to protect. Prepare to receive your just punishment.

lines.speaker: vistha_kai
lines.text: I am Vistha-Kai, Warden of the Corprusarium. I am here to warn you: do not harm the inmates. If you come to plunder the dungeon, you must endure their attacks, and take your chances with me, their Warden and Protector.

lines.speaker: vistha_kai
lines.text: I am Vistha-Kai. Knight.

lines.speaker: vistha_kai
lines.text: Lord Fyr shelters and maintains the victims of corprus disease here in the Corprusarium. He does them a great service, because no other could or would help them. He also does the world a great service by keeping them here where they can do no harm to others. The inmates are sad, distorted monsters, angry and cruel, and their sufferings are great, but they still live and feel, and I honor Lord Fyr's care and compassion for them.

lines.speaker: vistha_kai
lines.text: Yagrum Bagarn is in the bowels of the Corprusarium. Pass through the gate and go straight across to the next door. He rides in a four-legged cart. He's not as dangerous as the other corprus victims. I doubt he'll give you any trouble.

lines.speaker: vistha_kai
lines.text: You have been warned. Do not harm the inmates of the Corprusarium. If you plan to plunder the dungeon, you must endure their attacks, and mine.

lines.speaker: wanan_dum
lines.text: I am Wanan-Dum. Slave.

lines.speaker: wanan_dum

Welcome to Seyda Neen, stranger. Is there some specific place you're looking for?
What brings you to Suran, stranger? Are you looking for someone in particular?
%PCName. You look like you have something on your mind.
[You have failed your Oath of Silence]
A bribe? What do you think I am?
A bunch of thugs, that's what I say. Brought in to be the muscle for our new king.

A Dunmer woman, in a skirt and netch leather armor? With a dagger? No. Haven't seen anyone like that. But I recall someone -- maybe one of the sewer cleaners -- saying something about seeing a Dunmer woman down in the Underworks. Not that odd, really, though Dunmer are not seen as much in the Foreign Quarter. But in the Underworks. That's odd. Nothing down there but rats and sewers.

A fellow looking for trouble might take a peek around in the old Daedric ruins on an island to the south. Probably safer than stirring up trouble in town, anyway.

A fine woman. We're lucky to have her back in Mournhold. I know that a lot has been written about her, but don't believe everything you read. That woman's beauty is only equalled by her grace and wisdom. Shame she didn't pass that on to her son.
A fourth Great House style, the Velothi or Temple style, is evident in the monumental architecture, bridges, buttresses, and grand canals of the ancient religious center of Vivec City.
A gift from the All-Maker. It allows the hunter to track his prey, and it can be tunneled into for shelter.

A good strategy is to paralyze your opponent, cast some kind of touch spell that does damage for awhile, like poison, then retreat to a farther range to cast your targeted, long range spells. Recast paralyze if the creature isn't dead by the time they reach you again.
A good thrashing is what you need, %PCRace.
A good woman, but she spends too much time in the company of Halfhand. It is not appropriate while her husband is away on the hunt.
A group called the Dissident priests rebelled against Temple authority. The Temple outlawed the Dissident priests, and persecutes them.
A guard found Naryn walking around in his nightshirt near the fort. He said he didn't remember how he got there. Sounds to me like he's getting old before his time.

A guild guide is a spellcaster of the Mages Guild who provides magical transport for a small fee. You can only travel from one Mages Guild to another, but it is the fastest way to travel between Vivec, Balmora, Ald'ruhn, Caldera, and Sadrith Mora.

Erranil is the guild guide at the Ald'ruhn Mages Guild. For a small fee, she can teleport you directly to the Mages Guild at either Vivec, Balmora, Caldera, or Sadrith Mora.

A High Elf named Mossanon? I don't know anyone by that name. But there aren't many High Elves in Sadrith Mora. Why don't you ask Sinyaramen over at the Gateway Inn? He's a High Elf, and a trader. He might know.

A mabrigash is an Ashlander witch-warrior, a renegade wise woman who has forsaken the established rules of behavior for an Ashlander woman to become a master of dark magic and the weapons of war. By secret rituals the mabrigash steals a man's vital essence and makes herself a powerful sorcerer and warrior. The manifestation of her dark power is called a 'ghost snake' that paralyzes and drains a victim's vitality.
A miserable place, from what I've heard. Too cold for me. I understand there's someone in Khuul who will take folks there, though.
A prosperous day, Citizen %PCName. Can I help you look for someone in particular?
A rare thing indeed. Thanks.
A reputation for respecting life is good for business, and the Thieves Guild is very sensitive to public opinion.
A rumor says the Emperor has repealed the War Tax. We've heard nothing official here, but it's about damn time. We haven't had a war in ten years.

A sailor from Soulrest says he heard the Expeditionary Force has put down the tribal uprisings in Black Marsh. He says local traders expect exports of gold and timber to resume after the plantations and mines are rebuilt.
A secret cult called the Sixth House is killing Imperial citizens.

A skooma-addict, that one. His wife works all the time in the Hall, and he takes the money and spends it all on the skooma. He and his friends spend all their time down in the Underworks using the stuff. That poor woman.
A suggestion. Get yourself a more suitable outfit. Unless you don't mind being mistaken for a slave or a pauper.
A terrible place, I've heard. There's a boat from Khuul, if you have any reason to go.
A very good day to you, %PCName.

A well-marked road leads southeast to Ald'ruhn. Punibi Yahaz offers silt strider service to Ald'ruhn, Maar Gan, and Khuul from the strider port overlooking the river gorge. The fishing villages of Ald Velothi and Khuul lie to the north on the coast, but there's no direct or marked route -- you just have to travel cross-country north to the coast. Ald Velothi is west of Khuul, with the Daedric ruin of Ashalmawia in between.
About 50% of Vvardenfell's inhabitants are Dunmer. The other half are Redguard, Breton, Nord, Altmer, Dunmer, Bosmer, Imperial, Khajiit, Argonian, and Orc in roughly equal proportion.
Above all clans, we stand alone! We have few limitations to our power, so great is our gift. Our dark powers make us perfect predators, perfect warriors. Those who live in the sunlight fear our name.
According Morag Tong custom, killing civilians is scandalous, and grounds for expulsion.

According to the Collective Articles of the Council of the Great House Telvanni, out-house and outlander guests in Sadrith Mora may not travel in town or speak to or conduct business with citizens, tradesmen, or publicans unless they have Hospitality Papers. Hospitality Papers may be obtained from the Prefect of Hospitality, Angaredhel, at the Gateway Inn for 25 gold.

According to the Dunmer, animation or control of a deceased's flesh or spirit is righteous when practiced according to established cult ritual, but illegal and abominable when practiced by secular sorcerers. However, in Telvanni districts, necromancy is privately practiced by wizards in defiance of Temple censure.

According to the Morag Tong, killing civilians is wrong, and grounds for expulsion. Killing anyone but a victim marked by writ is dishonorable and incompetent. Killing a victim marked by a writ is sacred and honorable.
According to the unwritten Code of the Thieves Guild, killing is always inefficient, inelegant, and counter-productive.
Advancement in the Mages Guild does not occur by magic. Pay more attention to your duties and make sure you understand our requirements.
Aengoth the Jeweler is the mer you want.

Agning is the publican of the Six Fishes; he rents beds and sells food and sundries. The Imperial cult shrine services include a priest, healer, monk, enchanter, apothecary, trader, and savant. The Imperial Legion services of the Hawkmoth Legion Garrison include a healer, smith, master-at-arms, scout, trader, chaplain, and battlemage. For other services, visit Vivec City -- the Foreign Quarter, in particular, for Fighters Guild and Mages Guild services, and the Great House compounds for kin and retainers.
Alchemists are easy targets for inexperienced thieves. They have far too many ingredients for them to keep an eye on all of them all of the time.
Ald Redaynia is the site of an ancient ruined wizard's tower on the northern coast of Vvardenfell, on the western tip of a large island west of Sheogorad.
Ald Sotha is a large Daedric ruin in the southern Ascadian Isles region, within sight of Vivec City to the east.

Ald Sotha is a splendid Daedric ruin within sight of Vivec City. Though exotic and picturesque, it is a dangerous site, haunted by old magics, dark cultists, and their Daedric summonings, and not recommended for sightseers.
Ald Velothi is a tiny fishing village on the northern coast of the West Gash.

Aldmeri -- the Imperial usage is 'Elves' -- are long-lived, culturally conservative humanoids distinct from Tamriel's 'manish' races of the north and 'beast peoples' races of the southeast. By contrast with the manish tribes, Elven cultures and social institutions are stable and persistent; Elven nations are neither economically expansive nor militarily adventurous.

Aldmeris is the original Elvish language, still spoken as a first language among isolated Elven communities, and spoken and written by all educated Elves, and the language of the Elven arts. The root '-mer' is analogous with the root '-man' or '-men' in human language; thus, the Elves are mer as Humans are men.
Ald'ruhn is considered a Redoran city, even though only a few citizens actually belong to House Redoran.

Ald'ruhn is fortunate in having two enchanters and two alchemists. Even though Cienne Sintieve and Llether Vari are up in the more expensive Manor District, I think you'll find the selection and service with Tanar Llervi and Anarenen at the Mages Guild every bit as good. Of course, if you're affiliated with the Mages Guild, you'll want to try Tanar Llervi and Anarenen first.

Ald'ruhn is the district seat of House Redoran, and a large settlement. The Redoran Council chambers are located inside the shell of an ancient extinct giant crab. Tracks lead north to Maar Gan and Gnisis villages and south to Balmora.
Ald'ruhn would be a better place without you.

Ald'ruhn's Imperial cult shrine is in Fort Buckmoth, south of town. The altar there cures disease and poison. Cocistian Quaspus, the apothecary, sells cure potions, and they also have a savant, an enchanter, and a trader.
All right, stranger. Ask your question. If it's about something here in Molag Mar, maybe I can answer it.
All right, stranger. Tell me what you want. Services? Or are you here in Balmora for someone in particular?
All right, stranger. What's the deal? This is Ebonheart. Are you looking for someone in particular?
All right, stranger. Why are you here in Sadrith Mora? Are you looking for services? Or are you trying to find some specific place in town?
All right, you made your point.
All right. Ask your question.
All right. I've never seen you before. What do you want?
All right. We can talk.
All right. What is it this time? Are you looking for someone in particular in Seyda Neen?

All six Redoran councilors, Brara Morvayn, Hlaren Ramoran, Athyn Sarethi, Garisa Llethri, Miner Arobar, and Bolvyn Venim, live in the Manor District. Edwinna Elbert is Mages Guild steward, Percius Mercius is Fighters Guild steward. Old Methal Seran is an eminent Temple priest and scholar. Raesa Pullia is commandant of Fort Buckmoth, but Imsin the Dreamer is the chapter steward. The Redguard Hean is priest of the Imperial cult. Find Goren Andarys, guild steward of the Morag Tong, in the Manor District.

All sorts of people live here in St. Olms. Three Hlaalu lords also live here -- Crassius Curio, Yngling Half-Troll, and Dram Bero. A number of Hlaalu lords and retainers live in Hlaalu Compound and in St. Olms. Redorans live in Redoran Compound and Telvanni live in Telvanni Compound. Temple priests, clerks, and Ordinators are in the Hall of Wisdom and the Hall of Justice. Some fighters live and train at the Arena. Imperial guildsmen are in the Foreign Quarter.

All the important Telvanni retainers and mercenaries live here in the Telvanni Compound. Mavon Drenim, the ranking Telvanni lord here in Vivec, lives in the tower. Various Hlaalu retainers live in Hlaalu Compound, St. Olms, and St. Delyn. Redorans live in Redoran Compound. Temple priests, clerks, and Ordinators are in the Hall of Wisdom and the Hall of Justice. Some fighters live and train at the Arena. Imperial guildsmen are in the Foreign Quarter.

All the power in Mournhold starts with Almalexia at the Temple. Of course, no mere mortal is going to get access to the Lady of Mercy. But Fedris Hler, her steward, is quite approachable. Start with him, win his confidence, and then maybe things will open up for you.
Almalexia is one of the gods worshipped by the Dunmer in the Tribunal Temple.
Almalexia is one of the gods worshipped by the Dunmer in the Tribunal Temple.
Almalexia is one of the gods worshipped by the Dunmer in the Tribunal Temple.

Almalexia, our Lady of Mercy, dwells in her Temple. Her steward, Fedris Hler, and the Lord Archcanon, Gavas Drin, also reside in the Temple. King Hlaalu Helseth and his mother, Queen Barenziah, live in the Royal Palace. Tienius Delitian is Captain of the Royal Guard. It's a big city. If there's someone else you want, ask around.

Altmer are the light-skinned, tall Elven peoples of the Summerset Isles. 'High' is taken to mean variously 'tall,' 'proud,' and 'culturally snobbish.' In the Empire, 'High Elves' is the common usage. They consider themselves the most civilized culture of Tamriel, and, in truth, the common tongue of the Empire, Tamrielic, is based on their speech and writing, and most of the Empire's arts, crafts, and sciences are derived from High Elven traditions.
Always an honor, Nerevarine. How can I be of service?
Always an honor, Nerevarine. How can I be of service?

Always carry a jug of sujamma with you. That burst of strength, and the ability to penetrate armor and deal serious damage, will give you the one-time punch to face an opponent you normally can't handle.
Always happy to chat with people I like. And I like you.
Always happy to pass the time of day with you, %PCName. Maybe you've heard the latest rumors come to Ald'ruhn?

Always study your target, and take a good inventory of what he has before attempting to steal anything. If he has his eye on that shiny silver claymore, he won't notice you pocketing a few tarnished throwing stars.

Among Ashlanders, a gift is a token of courtesy among strangers, and affection among friends. When coming first among strangers, a thoughtful gift is a sign that you are cautious, and considerate, and aware of the other's wants and needs. Such is particularly useful for traders and travelers. Among friends, it is a private thing, and subtle, with great risks, for the test of the gift is how well it is tailored to the receiver.

An adventurer should know the basics of Imperial law concerning life and property. Verbal assault, pickpocketing, and trespassing are malfeasances, punishable by fines and compensation of less than 100 drakes, or by punitive labor. Theft and foul murder are felonies. Theft is punishable by fines and compensation proportional to the value of the property stolen, or by punitive labor. Foul murder is punishable by fines and compensation of at least 1000 drakes, or by punitive labor.

An adventurer should know the basics of Imperial law concerning life and property. Verbal assault, pickpocketing, and trespassing are minor crimes, punished by fines or hard labor. Theft and foul murder are felonies. Theft is punished by fines proportional to the value of the property stolen, or by hard labor. Foul murder is punishable by fines of at least 1000 drakes, or by hard labor.

An adventurer should know the basics of Imperial law concerning life and property. Verbal assault, pickpocketing, and trespassing are minor crimes, punished by fines or hard labor. Theft and foul murder are felonies. Theft is punished by fines proportional to the value of the property stolen, or by hard labor. Foul murder is punishable by fines of at least 1000 drakes, or by hard labor.
An Argonian! How exciting. I've never had an Argonian... customer.

An outlander is anyone born and raised outside of Morrrowind. Most Dunmer think anyone who isn't a native-born Dunmer is an outlander. Dunmer with Western words and ways are also immediately identified as outlanders -- Dunmer are very sensitive to accents, clothes, and manners in Morrowind. Outlanders are foreigners, and Morrowind doesn't like foreigners. It's not bad here in Hlaalu territory, but on the rest of Vvardenfell, folk are very cool to outlanders.
And how are you, Citizen %PCName? Is there some specific place in Ebonheart I can help you find?
And how do you plan on doing that?

And how do you think it was that bloated Imperial plutocrats got the charter to exploit the Caldera ebony deposits, and not a native Great House or local colonist? Big fat bribes, I tell you. And friends in high places.
And the same to you, Citizen. You've got a question for me? Or do you want to share a little secret?

Angaredhel is the Prefect of Hospitality here at the Gateway merchant inn, and Ery is Gateway's publican. The Telvanni Mouths are over at Telvanni Council Hall. Councilor Mage-Lord Master Neloth lives in Tel Naga, the wizard tower in the center of town. At Wolverine Hall, Hrundi the Nord is Fighters Guild steward, Procyon Nigilius is Mages Guild steward, and Aunius Autrus is the Imperial cult priest.
Anis Seloth the alchemist probably has some. Her shop is on the north side of town, next to Fara's Hole in the Wall.
Another of the All-Maker's wondrous creations. These creatures provide a great deal for our people. They are strong swimmers and fierce fighters, on land and in the sea.
Antonius WHOcius? Never heard of him.
Any way I can be of assistance, %PCName. Just tell me what you want to know.
Anything I can do for you, %PCName?
Anything you wish, %PCName. You know I like you, and want to help. In fact, with a good friend like you, I might even be persuaded to gossip about a little secret.
Are you interested in the healer's trade in Morrowind? Maybe you should talk with Ygfa at Fort Pelagiad in Pelagiad village. She's very nice, experienced, and very patient with questions.
Are you interested in the healer's trade in Morrowind? Maybe you should talk with Ygfa at Fort Pelagiad in Pelagiad village. She's very nice, experienced, and very patient with questions.
Are you looking for a specific place here in Molag Mar? Or do you want to know more about the Molag Amur region?
Are you looking for me? You want to join the Mages Guild?
Are you naturally unpleasant? Or do you have to work at it? Because you seem to have a gift for making enemies.
Are you okay? You don't look well...
Are you planning to be here in Molag Mar for a while? Do you need to know a little more about the Molag Amur region?
Are you still a member of the guild? Once Trebonius gives the authorization, we can discuss guild matters again.

Artifacts salvaged from Dwemer ruins are valuable, but protected under Imperial law, and trade in such artifacts is illegal. Most valuable are Dwarven weapons and armor, both for their superb craftsmanship, and for their value to collectors and scholars.
As a Quarra, you are gifted above all. Your strength and fighting skills are unmatched by any. Throw away your armor and weapons, for so great is our skill, that they are unneeded.

As everyone knows, the Thieves Guild is at war with the Camonna Tong. The Thieves Guild is the new gang in town, and the Camonna Tong, the old gang, wants the Thieves Guild dead. It's a mess. You don't want to get involved.

As is obvious, we are stronger, faster, more focused than normal creatures. You will find your body lacks the frailties of the normal man or mer. Disease is nothing, and those who would seek to paralyze you will always fail. We float through the night air with ease, always watching. And, of course, we can drain the warmblooded ones with but a touch, restoring our own life force.
As long as he holds the title, only Arch-Mage Trebonius in Vivec can grant you the title of Arch-Mage.
As long as you're here in Molag Mar, come see me if you need help. I would be happy to share the latest rumors. And sometimes I might even have a little secret you might find useful.

As you probably know, the Camonna Tong is the old criminal syndicate here in Morrowind. And, as EVERYONE around here knows, the Thieves Guild is at war with the Camonna Tong. We're the new gang in town, and the Camonna Tong want us to be the dead-and-gone gang. If you are looking for the Camonna Tong, their Balmora hangout is the cornerclub called the Council Club.
Ashlander nomadic camps are groups of small portable huts.

Ashlander nomadic camps have portable huts of hides stretched on chitin frames. These huts can be quickly dismantled and packed atop a guar when moving to new grazing and hunting grounds. The khan's hut is simply a larger, more elaborate version of a family hut.
Ashlanders are nomadic barbarians, living in camps of small portable huts.
Ashlanders are primitive native nomads living in the wilderness. There aren't many of them.
Ashlanders are the nomadic Dunmer barbarians of the Morrowind wastelands. They live in camps of small, mobile huts, herding guar and hunting wildlife for meat and hides.

Ashlanders are the nomadic Dunmer barbarians of the Morrowind wastelands. They live in camps of small, mobile huts, herding guar and hunting wildlife for meat and hides. By tradition, the Ashlanders claim the right to raid settlements and other tribes for booty and slaves. The Ashlanders worship their ancestors, and are led by their ashkhan war chiefs, counseled by the arcane wisdom and prophecies of their wise women. If you plan to visit them, you should know something of Ashlander customs.

Ashlanders may challenge a stranger who enters a yurt without invitation. Customs differ with different tribes, but leave when requested, and you may be forgiven. Be particularly careful about ashkhans -- tribal chiefs -- and wise women -- tribal seers and counselors. Some are welcoming, some are hostile. Be courteous, and leave if requested. If offended, they may attack.
Ashstorms here in the city? How can this happen? This isn't Vvardenfell! Something must be done quickly!

At first, it seemed the fuss about the Nerevarine prophecy was just silly superstition. Then I learned that the Dunmer have been waiting for Lord Nerevar to come back for centuries. The 'Incarnate', they call it. Every few years an Ashlander appears, and the tribes call him the Incarnate. Then the Temple goes out, hunts him down, and reveals him as a fake. Why does the Temple worry so much about it?
At night, when the snow starts falling, it's hard to see more than a few feet in front of you. Either use a good light source or get indoors until morning.
Awful creatures. As if the other things here weren't bad enough....
Back again, %PCName? What can I do for you? Just ask. Or were you hoping I had the latest rumors?
Bacola Closcius is the owner and proprietor of South Wall, a working-class Balmora cornerclub east of the Odai River.
Bacola Closcius? He's the owner. He must be around here somewhere.

Bad people? If you're looking for specific names from the Camonna Tong, you should go talk to the Thieves Guild. I can't afford to get involved. But the Thieves Guild has an interest, and maybe they'll be willing to stick their necks out. You might find someone who'll talk to you over at the South Wall Cornerclub.
Bad people? What do you mean? The Camonna Tong? I don't know about that. Understand? I don't want to know about that. None of my business. I stay out of the Council Club.

Bal Fell is the 'City of Stone,' an ancient First Era ruin in the southeastern islands and promontories of Azura's Coast. The site has a nasty reputation, and several Telvanni wizards currently have competing camps of hirelings and adventurers exploring and looting there. Legend says that Bal Fell was built on the site of an ancient Daedric worship center.
Bal Fell is the 'City of Stone,' an ancient First Era ruin in the southeastern islands and promontories of the Ascadian Isles.

Balmora is the Council Seat of Great House Hlaalu, and the largest town on Vvardenfell except for Vivec City. Located on the Odai River, and sitting astride the Ald'ruhn-Vivec road, Balmora is an important mercantile trade and travel center. High Town is the administrative center, with the Temple and manor houses. The shops, guilds, and tradehouses of the Commercial District are north of the river; Labor Town's modest cornerclubs and homes are south of the river.

Balmora is the district seat of House Hlaalu, and the largest settlement on Vvardenfell after Vivec City. Good roads lead north to Ald'ruhn and south to Caldera, Seyda Neen, and Vivec City. The Imperial Legion garrison of Fort Moonmoth lies south of Balmora.

Balmora's a big town. Think in terms of districts. High Town, on the hill to the west, has the Temple, Hlaalu Council Hall, rich manors, better shops, and the Morag Tong. The Commercial District, just west of the river, has the Fighters Guild and Mages Guild, shops and inns. Labor Town, east of the river, where the commoners and poor live, has only the South Wall Cornerclub. Fort Moonmoth, southeast of town, houses the Legion garrison and the Imperial cult.

Balmora's Imperial cult shrine is outside of town to the southeast, in Fort Moonmoth. Aldasi Thirothran is the priest in charge there. The altar there cures disease and poison, and they offer various other services as well.

Be smart. Join the Guild. Honor among thieves, right? You're new here, don't know your way around, get in a little trouble -- a lot of trouble, more likely. Oh, you'll learn, fast enough, I guess. But get gold on your head, and things get tougher. The Guild will steer you straight, towards the sweet and away from the sour. And they're a regular guild -- discounts on your training and services and everything. Do yourself a favor. Start easy, with friends. Then later, you want to freelance, fine.
